description_en: Modifies the properties of an Express Connect Router (ECR), such as its name
description_zh: 修改专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的名称等属性
name: ModifyExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en:
The name of ECR.

The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例的名称。
名称可以为空或长度为 0～128 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of ECR.

The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关实例的描述。
描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without modifying the service resource.
false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates that the request was successful. For more information about other error codes, see the "Error codes" section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为200表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage parameter.

If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, it indicates that the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of Name **** is illegal.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the ECR instance was successfully modified. Valid values:

true: The instance was modified.
false: The modification failed
Success.description_zh:
修改专线网关实例是否成功。取值：
True：成功。
False：失败
